Title: Visual Studio Code extension update for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) has recently been updated to bring new capabilities, features, and improvements. Highlights include a brand-new cluster create experience, reconcile/abort cluster, enhanced networking capabilities such as granular packet capture/tcp dump and more.

Learn more about the AKS Visual Studio Code extension’s releases and interact with the team here.

To download the Azure Kubernetes Service VS Code Extension, please visit the marketplace.
